The name Elizabeth, from which Betsy is derived, means 'God is my God,' emphasizing our relationship with Him and His role as our provider and sustainer. Elizabeth's story in the Bible, where she was barren but later gave birth to John the Baptist, also embodies the theme of God's promises and fulfillment. Ultimately, Betsy's meaning - 'God is my oath' or 'God is my satisfaction' - serves as a reminder that our trust and contentment should be in God alone.
